I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X, LinkedIn and Bluesky all pass for `content/blog/terraform-kubernetes/index.md`.

I counted the characters myself: X is 214 of 255, LinkedIn 703 of 2950 and Bluesky 243 of 300. None of the three has a URL, hashtag or markdown, and the paragraph structure is fine. The specifics in the copy trace to lines in the post, including the HashiCorp "intermittent and unpredictable errors" quote.

The review has three advisory notes, collapsed in the file, and none of them blocks a post:
- **X:** the copy names both limits up front, so it leaves little for the article to reveal.
- **LinkedIn:** the middle paragraph lists nearly every section of the article.
- **Bluesky:** it ends on a list of topics with no pointer to the article.

I didn't run the separate sub-agent passes that SKILL.md describes for the critique and suggestions steps. I applied the two rubrics myself instead.

I also added SKILL.md's CI call-to-action lines (how to apply the suggestions and how to re-run the review) before the footer. I didn't post a PR comment.
